rows.notice:
A = จำนวนผู้ป่วยด้วยโรคไวรัสตับอักเสบ บี เรื้อรัง และเสียชีวิตจากตับแข็ง (คนต่อสถาน บริการแยกด้วย CID) (K740, K741, K742, K746, K720, K721, K729)
B = จำนวนผู้ป่วยด้วยโรคไวรัสตับอักเสบ บี เรื้อรัง และเสียชีวิตจากมะเร็งตับ (คนต่อสถานบริการแยกด้วย CID) (C220)
C = จำนวนผู้ป่วยด้วยโรคไวรัสตับอักเสบ บี เรื้อรัง ที่ได้รับการวินิจฉัยเป็นตับแข็งและมะเร็งตับ และเสียชีวิต (K740, K741, K742, K746, K720, K721, K729 และ C220)
D = จำนวนผู้ป่วยโรคไวรัสตับอักเสบ บี เรื้อรัง ท้ังหมด B และ C ไม่ซ้ากัน

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, sum("b") as "b", sum("d") as "d", sum("a") as "a",SUM("c_01"+"c_02"+"c_03"+"c_04"+"c_05"+"c_06"+"c_07"+"c_08"+"c_09"+"c_10"+"c_11"+"c_12") as "c",  sum("c_01") as "c_01", sum("c_02") as "c_02", sum("c_03") as "c_03", sum("c_04") as "c_04", sum("c_05") as "c_05", sum("c_06") as "c_06", sum("c_07") as "c_07", sum("c_08") as "c_08", sum("c_09") as "c_09", sum("c_10") as "c_10", sum("c_11") as "c_11", sum("c_12") as "c_12" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

moo.label: หมู่
moo.query: SELECT s.areacode as a_code, CASE WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 7 THEN SUBSTRING( s.areacode FROM 7 FOR 1 ) WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 8 THEN SUBSTRING( s.areacode FROM 7 FOR 2 ) ELSE 'ไม่ระบุ' END AS a_name, sum("b") as "b", sum("d") as "d", sum("a") as "a", SUM( "c_01" + "c_02" + "c_03" + "c_04" + "c_05" + "c_06" + "c_07" + "c_08" + "c_09" + "c_10" + "c_11" + "c_12" ) as "c", sum("c_01") as "c_01", sum("c_02") as "c_02", sum("c_03") as "c_03", sum("c_04") as "c_04", sum("c_05") as "c_05", sum("c_06") as "c_06", sum("c_07") as "c_07", sum("c_08") as "c_08", sum("c_09") as "c_09", sum("c_10") as "c_10", sum("c_11") as "c_11", sum("c_12") as "c_12" FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) GROUP BY s.areacode ORDER BY s.areacode
